task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to pick the metal body sauce can up and set it beside the blue kitchenpot with smooth matte sides
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂拿起金属本体酱罐，将其放置在侧面光滑磨砂的蓝色厨房锅旁边
